bibliographic.title: One True Love
bibliographic.author: Brett Witty
bibliographic.description:
Through your pluck (and a little bit of luck) you have defeated your evil stepmother and brought lasting peace to the kingdom. Your last quest: rescue your one true love trapped by a horrible curse.
The life of a princess is never easy, though!

One True Love is a Twine game about kissing and making tough decisions for love. It was written for Smoochie Jam 2024.
